content: {"a_point": "When a party raises new facts in a cantonal appeal against a refusal of legal aid, the court will not consider them if they were not submitted to the first instance, and will reject the appeal as inadmissible under Art. 326 al. 1 CPC.", "b_propositions": [{"a_id": "S33", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "answer"}, {"a_id": "S27", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "rule"}, {"a_id": "S28", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "answer"}]}
